purpose: Owner rejected the regional visual pass: aim for wonder, distinct silhouettes, materials and traversal rather than labels/textures alone. First vertical slice is dunes and salt crust, pending actual rendered review.

sources.application: Dune fields, long stoss slopes, crests and steep lee faces.
Dry sand repose around 34 degrees; shallow upwind and steeper downwind sides.
Real dune fields can contain landforms tens to hundreds of metres high; prototype blends 35m and 120m ridge scales, not a worldwide measured size distribution.
Bright evaporite crust in enclosed arid basins; polygon/ridge detail, little vegetation and sediment-covered bedrock.
Polygonal salt pan surface relief and contrasting polygon/ridge structure.

not_claimed: No complete aeolian or evaporite hydrological simulation.
No universal mirror surface; the first salt slice is dry crust.
Numerical checks alone do not establish the visual target.

baseline_probe.source: fdae0803 with diagnostic-only additions; production geometry identical to selected f5385a89

review_status: PROTOTYPE: first native dune views rejected as bland; salt crust is recognisable and bare after rooting fix. Larger-context compound-dune/detail candidate pending actual native inspection. No shortcut change.

findings: SandSea still reads as broad rolling sand from inspected views.
Salt polygons and brighter crust appear, but unwanted rooted foliage remains.
Both native contexts exit 0; all walking eye clearances 1.8m.
Four walking headings plus morning/noon inspected; salt crust bare and polygonal.
Dunes still lack intermediate crests; adaptive detail estimator did not include new sand ridge errors.

next_candidate: Climbing secondary dunes on stoss flanks; primary slip faces kept clear.
Cached dune-cusp error included in existing screen-space adaptive terrain detail.
